hint: ผมมั่นใจว่า EKG นี้เป็น STEMI เฉียบพลัน

parsed.rationale: The ST segment is raised in leads III and aVF (about 2 mm in III, more than in II) and lowered in aVL and I as a mirror image, which meets STEMI criteria for an inferior MI; the ST rise in V1 also suggests the right ventricle is involved, though V4–V6 are hard to read because of baseline wander.
